# aap_organization (Resource)

Manage an Automation Controller organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aap_organization" "example" {
  name        = "example"
  description = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Organization description.
- `max_hosts` (Number) Maximum number of hosts allowed to be managed by this organization.
- `opa_query_path` (String) The query path of the OPA policy evaluated before jobs in this organization run, formatted as `package/rule`. Requires an automation controller with policy enforcement support.

### Read-Only

- `eda_id` (Number) Organization ID in the EDA API
- `gateway_id` (Number) Organization ID in the gateway API
- `id` (String) Organization ID from the controller API. See `gateway_id` or `eda_id` for the organization's ID in the other APIs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import aap_organization.example 1
```
